$comment: Refusals this amendment adds on surfaces outside kb/review.*: the delete guard (Amendment 4 D7) on the collab handler's node removal, and C9's agent write gate.

refusals.case: delete a node that has any revision (also the editor's delete and seed removal)

error.message: a node with a revision is never deleted; derogate it

refusals.case: an agent writes to a review-enabled KB before the deployment's assessment act

error.message: agent writes to review-enabled KBs are not enabled
